column7: \record Filter (A : TopMeetSemilattice) (\coerce F : A -> \Prop) { | filter-mono {a b : A} : F a -> a <= b -> F b | filter-top : F top | filter-meet {a b : A} : F a -> F b -> F (a ∧ b) }
\record CompleteFilter \extends Filter { \override A : CompleteLattice | filter-Join {C : A -> \Prop} : F (Join C) -> ∃ (w : C) (F w) }
\lemma filter-SJoin {I : \Type} {f : I -> A} {C : I -> \Prop} (FJ : F (CompleteLattice.SJoin f C)) : ∃ (i : C) (F (f i))
\lemma filter-IJoin {I : \Type} {f : I -> A} (FJ : F (CompleteLattice.IJoin f)) : ∃ (i : I) (F (f i))
\func SetFilter-map {X Y : \Set} (f : X -> Y) (F : SetFilter X) : SetFilter Y
\record ProperFilter \extends WeaklyProperFilter { | isProper {U : Set X} : F U -> ∃ U | isWeaklyProper => \lam Fb => (\case isProper Fb \with { | inP (x, inP (_, (), _)) }) }
\func WeaklyProperFilter-map {X Y : \Set} (f : X -> Y) (F : WeaklyProperFilter X) : WeaklyProperFilter Y
\func ProperFilter-map {X Y : \Set} (f : X -> Y) (F : ProperFilter X) : ProperFilter Y
